info.name: biblio — Integration sequence
info.description: Run against a disposable/local library. Set admin credentials for an existing ADMIN and userPassword/queueUserPassword (8–72 UTF-8 bytes). Uses real login cookies only. Core runs without an AI key. AI folder requires OpenAI plus indexed vector search, or the isolated integration fixture. Run Cleanup last. Creates two test users; no production accounts are deleted automatically.

exec: pm.test("Attributed library sources", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.insufficientContext).to.eql(false); pm.expect(d.sources[0].bookId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("bookId")); pm.expect(d.sources[0].chapter).to.eql("Chapter 1"); });
